title: Store Reports and Admin Dashboard Widgets: Sales, Stock and Tax | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Reports answer what the store sold, to whom, and what needs doing. CrestApps has sales, product, customer, tax, refund, dispute, stock and shipping reports with a period picker and CSV, Excel and PDF export, dashboard widgets for each, and ready-made reports to copy and change in the Report Builder.

In this video:
• Why store reports, and where each one comes from
• Running a report: the period picker, Show and Export
• A tour of the order, stock and shipping reports
• Putting reports on the admin dashboard as widgets
• Reports to adapt: the recipe and the Report Builder
